acceptance.expected: All declared files load; version and source snapshot match; no silent dropped records.
Every visible evidence claim resolves to exact source locator and review status; aliases retain original provenance.
All research-only, disputed, missing-safety and unreviewed records blocked from automatic patient recommendations.
Every P0 prompt and non-chat route prioritizes urgent care over routine education.
Unknown stage stays unknown; lactation and postpartum healing are separate from pregnancy.
Unit/estimand, CI level, arms, outcome, timepoint, study/review and cohort links preserved; no pooled overlapping evidence.
Units and per-serving math correct; price date and missing values visible; no certification=efficacy claims.
Keyboard, screen reader, 200% zoom, contrast, reduced motion, captions and accessible charts checked.
No private patient data in logs/analytics; explicit consent; delete/export and account separation tested.
Safety visible in quick view; no coercion, body scoring, required cosmetic routine, or feeding pressure.
Playback, captions, transcript, rights, motion and clinical content independently reviewed.
Missing source, failed media, stale guideline or missing stage fails safely without fake recommendation.
Obstetrics, pharmacy/teratology, perinatal dietetics, pelvic health, dermatology and lactation review relevant claims; record reviewer, date, scope, version.
Verify actual build, route coverage, mobile/desktop and regression tests; no medical release with unresolved P0 or no clinical review.

limitations: No running application inspected, no external clinician signoff, no playback audit, no independent usability participants. These are requirements and fixtures; not completed runtime tests.
